summary: Tested multi-level admin (super_admin / hr_leave) feature end-to-end. 27/27 backend pytest cases PASS, 15/15 frontend Playwright cases PASS. Migration of legacy 'admin' -> 'super_admin' verified. User CRUD, role-based 403 enforcement, hr_leave auto-redirect to /leave, and last-super-admin protection all working.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2917 lines — still recommend splitting into routers (auth, users, payroll, leave, portal, thr) for maintainability.

delete_user 'last super_admin' guard is correct but the self-delete check fires first, so the 'minimal harus ada 1 Super Admin' branch only triggers if a non-self super_admin tries to delete another super_admin while only 2 exist — covered indirectly via UI test.
Role list in VALID_ROLES is hardcoded; if more roles added later (e.g. payroll_only), consider an enum + helper to avoid scattering set-literals throughout endpoint deps.
_user_view re-maps legacy 'admin' -> 'super_admin' on read; combined with the startup $set migration this is redundant once migration has run — safe but could be simplified after first deploy.
Frontend ProtectedRoute correctly redirects unauthorized roles; confirmed /employees, /payroll, /users, / all redirect hr_leave to /leave.
Some 401s logged to console on /login page from in-flight /auth/me probes before login — harmless but creates console noise; could short-circuit when token cookie is absent.
updated_files: /app/memory/test_credentials.md (added super_admin + hr_leave creds and route info)
test_credentials: Super Admin: admin@payroll.id / admin123 (role super_admin, lands at /). HR Leave: hrcuti@payroll.id / cuti123 (role hr_leave, auto-redirect to /leave). Portal: udin0279@gmail.com + NIK 211 unchanged.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_- and uitest_-prefixed users via POST /api/users and clean them up. hrcuti@payroll.id (cuti123) re-asserted on test run. Existing leave_requests data untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-level admin is wired and stable. Backend role helpers: require_super_admin (full admin endpoints) and require_leave_access (super_admin + hr_leave for /api/leave/*). User CRUD at /api/users with self-delete + last-super-admin guards. Frontend: Layout filters nav items by item.roles, ProtectedRoute(allowedRoles=['super_admin']) on admin routes, HomeRedirect sends hr_leave to /leave. Footer shows role badge via data-testid='user-role-badge'. data-testids on Users page: nav-users, add-user-btn, user-name, user-email, user-password, role-super_admin, role-hr_leave, submit-user, edit-user-{id}, delete-user-{id}, user-row-{id}. Note: legacy 'admin' role docs migrate to 'super_admin' on every startup.
